description: Bass drum with an analog-modelled oscillator section and a noise section able to produce many kinds of click, and a stress input that shapes the level through a vactrol model

params.text: Sets the pitch the drum starts from when it is hit
Offsets the pitch of the drum one octave up or down, and with nothing patched to the TUNE input the range runs from F0 to F2
Sets how long the pitch takes to move from the pitch set by BEND to the pitch of the drum
Sets how long the drum sounds
Sets the level of the noise
Changes the wave of the main oscillator and adds distortion, for a more aggressive sound
Picks the noise oscillator used by the noise section
Changes the perceived pitch of the noise
Attenuates and inverts the FURY input before it is added to the FURY knob
Attenuates and inverts the DECAY input before it is added to the DECAY knob
Attenuates and inverts the DEPTH input before it is added to the DEPTH knob
Attenuates and inverts the SHIFT input before it is added to the SHIFT knob
Expands the range of every control on the module, which allows more aggressive sounds

inputs.text: A control voltage added to the fury, scaled by the FURY attenuverter
A control voltage added to the decay, scaled by the DECAY attenuverter
A control voltage added to the depth, scaled by the DEPTH attenuverter
A control voltage added to the shift, scaled by the SHIFT attenuverter
A signal above 2V triggers the sound, and it has to fall below 2V and rise again to trigger it once more
Sets the pitch of the drum, offset by the TUNE knob
Sets the level of the sound through a vactrol model, which softens the transitions: 0V gives about 40% of the level, 10V the full level, and a negative voltage takes it below 40%

notes: The drum is silent until a signal above 2V arrives at the trigger input; nothing on the panel makes it sound
